pcs.pc_description: marshal/guide the customer to the designated island and manage queue
stay at the designated island and keep the island in clean condition at all times
greet the customer
ask the customer to park the vehicle in a way where he/she is able to see the dispensing unit display
ask the customer to switch off the vehicle and his/her mobile for safety
inform the customer of any available schemes/offers in the retail outlet
ask the customer about the required type of fuel and quantity to be filled
prompt for tank full
prompt for branded products
confirm the customers order by repeating the fuel type and quantity
pre-set the customers order quantity in the DU after customer has seen Zero display, before commencing filling
ask the customer to vacate the vehicle in case of CNG and two wheelers
keep the hose at a safe distance from the vehicle
avoid dragging the hose to make it reach the vehicle for fuelling
ensure that the nozzles, vapour guards/caps are in normal position
ensure nozzle cuff guard fits properly over the vehicle tank opening
hold the nozzle till fuelling is completed
in case of CNG place rubber mat on the battery terminal while filling
ensure no one is speaking on the mobile phone around the car while fuelling
show final metre reading and sales amount to the customer
promptly wipe any spillage on the vehicle body
provide automated/manual) bill to the customer, as requested
provide hard pad for signing the merchant copy in case of card payment
prompt the customer for checking the air in their vehicles tyres
enquire if the customer needs lubricant, coolant, brake fluid, etc. for the vehicle
obtain feedback from the customer for improvement in service
thank the customer and request them to visit again
